content.title: 形式宾语 it(find / make / think it + adj./n. + to do / that…)速查
content.intro: 当不定式或 that 从句作宾语、后面又跟形容词或名词作宾语补足语时,把真正的宾语后移,用 it 作形式宾语顶在前面。判断口诀:动词后先填 it,真正的宾语(to do / that…)躲在补足语后面。

rows: find/think/feel it + 形容词 + to do
We found it hard to remove the rabbits.(真宾语=to remove…)
make/find/think it + 形容词 + that 从句
The incident made it clear that the problem had to be solved.
consider/make it + 名词 + to do
They consider it an honour to protect the bees.(名词作宾补)
find / make / think / consider / feel + it + 补足语 + 真宾语

specialRules.rule: 只有当宾语是‘后移的不定式 / that 从句’时才用 it;若宾语是普通名词则不用
specialRules.mark: find it hard to do √ / find the book hard(无 it)

specialRules.rule: 补足语可以是形容词(clear, hard, necessary)也可以是名词(a rule, an honour, a pity)
specialRules.mark: make it a rule to… / think it a pity that…

specialRules.rule: it 只是占位,本身无词义,不可换成 that / this / them
specialRules.mark: make it clear that… √ / make that clear that… ×

specialRules.rule: think it important that… 后的从句常用虚拟语气(should + 动词原形,should 可省)
specialRules.mark: think it important that everyone (should) join

why: 英语习惯把太长的不定式或从句放到句末,以免句子‘头重脚轻’;于是先用 it 顶住宾语的位置,真正的宾语后置,读起来更顺、更地道。
gaokaoPoints: 形式宾语 it 与形式主语 it 的区别:形式宾语出现在‘动词+it+补足语+真宾语’里(make it clear that…)。
语法填空 / 改错高频:漏掉 it 是典型错误(We found ___ hard to…)。

examVsReal.exam: I find it difficult to finish the task.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: This task is really hard to finish.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考形式宾语;口语里常直接换个说法把形容词放前面

examVsReal.exam: They made it clear that smoking was banned.(考试)
examVsReal.note: 真实英语口语可用更短、更直接的表达,但书面写作仍用 make it clear that…
